exposure: single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in sex hormone-related genes (TXNRD2/COMT rs3788314, SULT1A2/SULT1A1 rs4788073, CYP17A1 rs4919690 and rs4919687, LHCGR rs10180731, GNRHR rs2630488, HSD17B3 rs8190512, SULF1 SNPs)
cohort: The study included 436 pregnant women, comprising 203 with preeclampsia and 233 healthy or normal pregnant women.
finding: Genetic polymorphisms in TXNRD2/COMT, SULT1A2/SULT1A1, CYP17A1, HSD17B3, GNRHR, LHCGR, and SULF1 were found to be associated with the risk of preeclampsia, especially early-onset and severe preeclampsia.
